nodes.description: Immutable ERC20 token held by the timelock contract.
Immutable beneficiary address that can receive released tokens.
Start timestamp of the token release period (day aligned).
End timestamp of the release period; mutable in terminate().
Total amount of tokens allocated as benefit; reduced on terminate().
Cumulative amount already withdrawn by the beneficiary.
Flag indicating the contract has been terminated.
Address of the current contract owner.
Deploys the timelock, sets token, beneficiary, release window and total benefit; also sets owner via Ownable.
Time-based linear release calculation using block.timestamp, _releaseStartTime and _releaseEndTime.
Returns _totalBenefit - releasedBalance().
Public withdrawal of released tokens to the beneficiary; updates _withdrawedBalance then executes token transfer.
onlyOwner termination: shrinks _totalBenefit to releasedBalance(), resets _releaseEndTime and sweeps remaining tokens to owner.
Returns the current owner address.
onlyOwner function that transfers ownership to a new address.
onlyOwner function that sets the owner to the zero address.
Internal ownership update writing _owner and emitting OwnershipTransferred.

Miner-influenceable time input driving the release schedule and termination.
External token transfer to _beneficiary executed at the end of withdraw().
External token transfer of residual balance to owner executed in terminate().
Arithmetic state update _withdrawedBalance += amount in withdraw().
Arithmetic (_totalBenefit * passedDays) / totalDays computing the vested amount.

constructor parameter totalBenefit_ is assigned to _totalBenefit

msg.sender (via _msgSender) is passed as newOwner to _setOwner in the Ownable constructor
releasedBalance() depends on block.timestamp for the vesting schedule
terminate() recomputes _releaseEndTime from block.timestamp
constructor validates _releaseEndTime against block.timestamp
releasedBalance() scales _totalBenefit by elapsed days
_releaseStartTime is read to compute elapsed days
_releaseEndTime bounds the released amount
unreleasedBalance() subtracts releasedBalance() from _totalBenefit
releasedBalance() result is consumed by unreleasedBalance()
withdraw() reads _withdrawedBalance in its require and amount computation
withdraw() consumes releasedBalance() to size the payout
computed amount is added into _withdrawedBalance
amount is the value forwarded in the external token transfer
_beneficiary is the recipient of the transferred tokens
terminate() overwrites _totalBenefit with releasedBalance()
owner() address is the recipient of the residual token sweep
amountToWithdraw is the value sent to the owner on termination
passedDays is a multiplier in the release arithmetic
totalDays is the divisor in the release arithmetic
withdraw() invokes releasedBalance() for its checks
unreleasedBalance() invokes releasedBalance()
withdraw() executes the external safeTransfer operation
terminate() executes the external safeTransfer operation
terminate() invokes releasedBalance() to shrink _totalBenefit
transferOwnership() delegates the write to _setOwner
renounceOwnership() delegates the write to _setOwner
Ownable constructor calls _setOwner(_msgSender())
msg.sender is checked against owner() by the onlyOwner guard on terminate()
msg.sender is checked against owner() by the onlyOwner guard on transferOwnership()
msg.sender is checked against owner() by the onlyOwner guard on renounceOwnership()

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is only a placeholder for the _token state variable assigned in the constructor function.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is only a placeholder for the _beneficiary state variable assigned in the constructor function.
Constructor parameter releaseStartTime_ is day-aligned and consumed entirely inside the constructor function.
Constructor parameter daysOfTimelock_ is used only to derive _releaseEndTime inside the constructor function.
Constructor parameter totalBenefit_ is only a placeholder for the _totalBenefit state variable set in the constructor function.
Parameter newOwner exists only to be forwarded by transferOwnership() into the ownership update path.
Local amount in withdraw() is the exact value handed to the external token transfer operation.
Local amountToWithdraw in terminate() is the exact value handed to the residual token sweep operation.
Local passedDays is an intermediate operand of the vesting multiplication/division arithmetic.
Local totalDays is the denominator operand of the vesting multiplication/division arithmetic.
Local oldOwner in _setOwner() is a transient cache used only for the ownership write performed by _setOwner().
